---

### Why only the United States?

| EGOT winner | Country of origin | First EGOT‑award (year) | Last EGOT‑award (year) | Span (years) |
|-------------|-------------------|------------------------|-----------------------|--------------|
| **Bob Dylan** | United States (born Duluth, Minnesota) | Grammy – *Best Folk Recording* (1963) | Emmy – *Outstanding Music Direction* for “The Simpsons” (2021) | **58 years** |
| *(No other EGOT winner reaches a 40‑year span)* | – | – | – | – |

#### Other EGOT winners (U.S. or non‑U.S.) and their spans  

| Winner | Country | First EGOT award | Last EGOT award | Span |
|--------|---------|------------------|----------------|------|
| Richard Rodgers | United States | Oscar 1945 | Tony (Special) 1979 | 34 yr |
| Whoopi Goldberg | United States | Grammy 1985 | Tony 2002 | 17 yr |
| Mel Brooks | United States | Oscar 1971 | Tony 2001 | 30 yr |
| Mike Nichols | United States | Grammy 1962 | Tony 2001 | 39 yr |
| Robert Lopez | United States | Oscar 2007 | Emmy 2015 | 8 yr |
| John Legend | United States | Grammy 2005 | Tony 2021 | 16 yr |
| Andrew Lloyd Webber | United Kingdom | Tony 1976 | Emmy 2000 | 24 yr |
| Alan Menken | United States | Oscar 1992 | Tony 2022 | 30 yr |
| Rita Moreno | United States / Puerto Rico (American) | Oscar 1962 | Emmy 1977 | 15 yr |

All of the above have **less than 40 years** between their first and last EGOT‑winning award, so they do not meet the “greater than 40 years” criterion.

---

### Conclusion
The only EGOT winner whose career gap between the first and the final EGOT award exceeds 40 years is **Bob Dylan**, and he is **American**. Consequently, the answer to the question is:

**United States**.
